subject: Climate & Environment
title: Mass Timber: Building with Wood
description: Learn Mass Timber: Building with Wood in one minute.

hook.text: A wooden skyscraper sounds crazy. But engineered timber is now rivaling steel and concrete.

buildup.text: Cross-laminated timber is layered and glued into panels as strong as steel per unit weight.

discovery.text: Wood stores carbon. A timber building is essentially a carbon vault that people live in.

twist.text: Replacing concrete and steel with timber could avoid up to 31% of industrial emissions in construction.

climax.text: The world's tallest timber building stands 85.4 meters in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

punchline.text: The future of construction might grow in a forest.

quiz.question: Why is mass timber considered climate-friendly?
options: Wood stores carbon and replaces emissions-heavy materials
Wood is cheaper to produce than concrete

details.summary: Mass timber uses engineered wood products like cross-laminated timber to construct buildings up to 20 stories tall. Timber sequesters carbon in the structure itself, replaces carbon-intensive steel and concrete, and can be manufactured with far lower emissions in well-managed forestry systems.
details.whyItMatters: Concrete and steel together account for over 10 percent of global CO2 emissions. Substituting mass timber stores carbon rather than releasing it, offering a powerful emissions reduction in construction.
takeaways: Cross-laminated timber can replace steel and concrete
Timber buildings store carbon within their structure
Wood sourced responsibly has much lower embodied carbon

faq.question: Is mass timber safe in fires?
faq.answer: Engineered timber chars on the surface during a fire, forming an insulating layer that protects the structural core. Mass timber buildings meet or exceed fire safety codes. Some perform better than steel, which can lose strength rapidly in extreme heat.

faq.question: How tall can mass timber buildings go?
faq.answer: The tallest mass timber building as of 2025 is the 25-story Ascent Tower in Milwaukee. Engineers believe 30-plus stories are feasible. Hybrid designs combining timber with some steel or concrete are extending these limits further.
